LESSON: NAME OF GOD

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.4: Name of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Name of God. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Name of God
2. Give Kenyan examples for Name of God
3. Practise Name of God at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: NAME OF GOD
This lesson teaches Name of God for PP2 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Name of God
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Name of God
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Name of God at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Name of God using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Name of God above.
2. Explain Name of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Name of God.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Name of God with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Name of God important for a PP2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Name of God
2. Give Kenyan examples for Name of God
3. Practise Name of God at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
